desc.zh: “两样都用”属于一个人的一天，不属于某一行：先按人-天贴标签，再用固定的日期×平台格子和 LEFT JOIN 保住零行。
desc.en: “Both” belongs to a person's day, not to a row: label each person-day first, then keep zero rows with a fixed date × platform grid and a LEFT JOIN.

complexity: O(n log n) time with sort-based grouping (expected O(n) with hashing) for n Spending rows; O(n) intermediate space

concepts.name: Group by person-day before labelling
concepts.description: A label such as both is a property of all of one user's rows on one day, so group by date and user first.

concepts.name: Output grid with LEFT JOIN for zero rows
concepts.description: Build every date x label cell first, LEFT JOIN the data, and count a column so empty cells give 0.
